svg.aria-label: lockssh: Claude Code checks nginx on a server through lockssh. The allow-listed status and log commands run at once, with the client's address masked; the restart matches no allow rule, so lox run asks the human, who types y, and the agent runs it once. The SSH key stays in the lockssh console.
